تفترضون (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِضُونَ (taftariḍūna) /taf.ta.ri.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# تُفْتَرَضُونَ (tuftaraḍūna) /tuf.ta.ra.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
